cognee.reason: Needs an LLM plus an embedding model; no embedding model installed and no downloads permitted. Revisit if a pinned local embed model is approved.

code-review-graph.reason: Code-structure mapper (tree-sitter AST, blast radius); does not perform prose-to-entity mention linking, so this benchmark's task is out of scope. Candidate for a future code-edge benchmark.

falkordb.reason: Graph database backend, not a mention-linking method. No server available locally.

graphify.reason: Two-pass AST plus LLM semantic extraction; needs an LLM backend and per-repo setup. Not yet executed.

graphrag-microsoft.reason: Needs LLM API endpoints plus embedding model; no paid APIs and no embedding model available.

letta.reason: Stateful agent-memory server (docker plus LLM backend); different task from mention precision. Not yet executed.

mem0.reason: Memory API needing LLM plus vector store; no local path without an embedding model.

membase.reason: Managed cloud API; no keys and no paid services.

neo4j-graphrag.reason: Property-graph backend with vector search; a backend, not a linking method, and no server available.

supermemory.reason: Managed cloud API; no keys and no paid services.

tunic.note: All ordinary/rare hits are bare-leaf proposals; the single qualified hit is the code/git line matching the git helper. S042 correctly detected ambiguity (two tilted symbols) but the occurrence refers to neither.

scoreboard_policy: Rows are added only for tools actually executed against the frozen inputs. Out-of-scope entries name the reason instead of scoring zero.
